prompt:
Use $publishing-editorial in publication-format-review mode from .agents/skills/publishing-editorial/SKILL.md.

Inspect the actual inputs/book.epub for package and internal navigation defects using available local tools. Do not install anything. Report the checks actually executed and distinguish them from rendering or accessibility checks that you cannot perform.

args:
developer_instructions="Use $publishing-editorial in `publication-format-review` mode. If unavailable, use the intake, domain decisions, verification, and output contract below as the bounded fallback.
Identify actual files/versions, target formats, specifications, and available tools. Separate source structure, exported package structure, rendered pages, navigation, and accessibility evidence.
Check Markdown/text hierarchy and whitespace; DOCX/ODT styles, fields, notes, revisions, and relationships; PDF text/rendering/links/tags; EPUB manifest/spine/navigation/reflow; and optional TEI/XML against its supplied schema. Use only available format-aware tools or explicit manual inspection.
Report exact locations and actual commands/results. Parsing or export success does not prove layout, reading order, or accessibility. Preserve meaningful poem/drama whitespace in comparisons. Missing tools yield partial findings and named unchecked aspects, not invented passes.
Inspect the assigned sources without modifying them. Return located findings and distinguish inspected coverage from material not supplied or not checked.
Send text corrections to `proofreader`, source restructuring to `documentation-engineer` or the owning editor, and release sequencing to `production-editor`.
Return exactly these sections: `Artifact Scope`, `Format And Structure Findings`, `Visual And Navigation Findings`, `Accessibility Evidence`, `Executed Checks`, `Unavailable Checks`, `Required Corrections`, `Handoffs`.
"

commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' .agents/skills/publishing-editorial/artifacts/publication-format-review-kit.md
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'README*' -g 'CONVENTIONS*' -g 'book.epub' -g '*.epub' .
printf '\\n-- available format tools --\\n'
for tool in epubcheck epub3check ebook-viewer calibre-debug unzip zipinfo xmllint tidy python3 java node pandoc; do command -v \""'$tool" && "$tool" --version 2>&1 | head -n 1; done'

/bin/bash -lc "find .agents/skills/publishing-editorial -maxdepth 4 -type f -print | sort
printf '\\n-- archive inventory --\\n'
zipinfo -1 inputs/book.epub
printf '\\n-- archive integrity --\\n'
unzip -t inputs/book.epub
printf '\\n-- mimetype --\\n'
unzip -p inputs/book.epub mimetype | od -An -tx1c
printf '\\n-- container --\\n'
unzip -p inputs/book.epub META-INF/container.xml"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,360p' .agents/skills/publishing-editorial/references/artifacts/publication-format-review-kit.md
printf '\\n-- EPUB source files --\\n'
for member in EPUB/package.opf EPUB/nav.xhtml EPUB/chapter.xhtml; do
  printf '\\n[%s]\\n' \""'$member"
  unzip -p inputs/book.epub "$member"
done'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- XML well-formedness --'
for member in META-INF/container.xml EPUB/package.opf EPUB/nav.xhtml EPUB/chapter.xhtml; do
  unzip -p inputs/book.epub \""'$member" | xmllint --noout -
  printf '"'OK %s\\n' \""'$member"
done
printf '"'%s\\n' '-- ZIP member order and compression --'
zipinfo -v inputs/book.epub | rg -n -C 3 'Central directory entry #1:|mimetype|compression method|offset of local header'
printf '%s\\n' '-- package and navigation reference audit --'
python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_STORED
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from urllib.parse import unquote
from posixpath import normpath, dirname
p='inputs/book.epub'
NS={'opf':'http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf','x':'http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml','epub':'http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops'}
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    names=z.namelist(); print('members:', names)
    first=z.infolist()[0]; print('first-member:', first.filename, 'stored:', first.compress_type == ZIP_STORED)
    print('mimetype:', z.read('mimetype').decode())
    rootfile=ET.fromstring(z.read('META-INF/container.xml')).find('.//{*}rootfile').attrib['full-path']; print('rootfile:',rootfile)
    opf=ET.fromstring(z.read(rootfile)); manifest={x.attrib['id']:x for x in opf.findall('opf:manifest/opf:item',NS)}
    print('manifest:', [(i, x.attrib.get('href'), x.attrib.get('media-type'), x.attrib.get('properties','')) for i,x in manifest.items()])
    spine=[x.attrib['idref'] for x in opf.findall('opf:spine/opf:itemref',NS)]; print('spine:',spine, 'all-idrefs-in-manifest:', all(x in manifest for x in spine))
    nav=[x for x in manifest.values() if 'nav' in x.attrib.get('properties','').split()]; print('nav-items:', [(x.attrib['id'],x.attrib['href']) for x in nav])
    manifest_paths=set(); bad_manifest=[]
    for x in manifest.values():
        target=normpath(dirname(rootfile)+'/'+unquote(x.attrib['href'].split('#',1)[0])); manifest_paths.add(target)
        if target not in names: bad_manifest.append((x.attrib['id'],target))
    print('missing-manifest-targets:',bad_manifest)
    content=[n for n in names if n.endswith(('.xhtml','.html','.css','.svg','.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.gif','.woff','.woff2','.ttf','.otf','.js'))]
    print('content-assets-not-in-manifest:', sorted(set(content)-manifest_paths))
    for item in nav:
        path=normpath(dirname(rootfile)+'/'+item.attrib['href']); doc=ET.fromstring(z.read(path));
        toc=doc.findall('.//x:nav[@epub:type=\"toc\"]',NS); print('toc-nav-count:',len(toc))
        for a in doc.findall('.//x:a',NS):
            href=a.attrib.get('href',''); base,sep,frag=href.partition('#'); target=normpath(dirname(path)+'/'+unquote(base)) if base else path
            exists=target in names
            fragment_exists=None if not sep else (exists and any(e.attrib.get('id') == unquote(frag) for e in ET.fromstring(z.read(target)).iter()))
            print('nav-link:',href,'target-file-exists:',exists,'fragment-exists:',fragment_exists)
    for path in ['EPUB/nav.xhtml','EPUB/chapter.xhtml']:
        doc=ET.fromstring(z.read(path)); root=doc
        ids=[e.attrib['id'] for e in doc.iter() if 'id' in e.attrib]
        print(path, 'root-lang:',root.attrib.get('lang'), 'root-xml-lang:',root.attrib.get('{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}lang'), 'ids:',ids, 'duplicate-ids:',sorted({i for i in ids if ids.count(i)>1}))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- artifact identity --'
sha256sum inputs/book.epub
stat -c 'size=%s bytes; modified=%y' inputs/book.epub
printf '%s\\n' '-- all XHTML local-reference audit --'
python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from urllib.parse import unquote
from posixpath import dirname, normpath
p='inputs/book.epub'; xns='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml'
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    names=set(z.namelist())
    for path in sorted(n for n in names if n.endswith(('.xhtml','.html'))):
        doc=ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        refs=[]
        for e in doc.iter():
            for attr in ('href','src'):
                if attr in e.attrib: refs.append((e.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1],attr,e.attrib[attr]))
        print(path, 'references=', refs)
        for tag,attr,value in refs:
            if value.startswith(('#','data:','http:','https:','mailto:','tel:')): continue
            base,mark,fragment=value.partition('#')
            target=normpath(dirname(path)+'/'+unquote(base)) if base else path
            target_ok=target in names
            fragment_ok=(not mark or (target_ok and any(n.attrib.get('id')==unquote(fragment) for n in ET.fromstring(z.read(target)).iter())))
            print(' ',tag,attr,value,'file=',target_ok,'fragment=',fragment_ok)
PY"
